title: Compaction Shredder
blurb: Feed a long agent transcript into a graphite industrial shredder. Boilerplate becomes flying confetti; why / paths / TODOs eject as labeled KEEP strips — a toy metaphor for LLM context compaction.

title: Superposition Orrery
blurb: A tiny ReLU network trains live in your browser to fit n sparse features into 2 or 3 dimensions. Each brass arm is one feature’s direction. Raise sparsity and the arms snap into antipodal pairs, a pentagon, an octahedron, a square antiprism — the geometry of Anthropic’s Toy Models of Superposition. Real training, no pre-baked weights.

title: Lumen Landing
blurb: One prompt — “make the flashiest landing page you can” — and an AI coding agent shipped this single HTML file: a raymarched liquid-metal hero, 24,000 GPU particles morphing word → sphere → knot → galaxy, live spring physics, zero dependencies. Lumen is fictional; the page is the demo.

title: Podium Machine
blurb: Six fictional toy models, one toy test, seven eval knobs — 432 setups, and every model can be No.1. Flip a knob and the leaderboard reshuffles; target any model and RIG IT brute-forces the setup that crowns it. Synthetic scores.

title: Loss Chord
blurb: A toy optimizer descends a loss surface you primarily hear: pitch and chord tension track loss, rhythm tracks step size. Drag the learning rate — sweet spot resolves the chord; too high and it screams.

title: Injection Heist
blurb: You are a coding agent reading a fake repo. Flag the hidden prompt injection before tools arm. CRT terminal heist — toy game, not a scanner.

title: RoPE Carousel
blurb: A Victorian carousel for Rotary Position Embeddings: each horse is a frequency pair; drag to advance position and watch phases spin.

title: Byte Pair Forge
blurb: A blacksmith forge for Byte-Pair Encoding: hammer the hottest letter pairs until words become tokens.

title: Expert Post
blurb: A 1920s brass pneumatic-tube mailroom: each token is sealed in a capsule and whooshed to specialist desks by a toy Mixture-of-Experts router.

title: Token Departures
blurb: A split-flap departures board of next-token odds. Pull the temperature and top-p levers, watch the odds re-flap, dispatch a word.

title: Snowflake Net
blurb: Fold paper like a ReLU net folds space, make one cut, unfold a decision boundary.

title: Phase Choir
blurb: Kuramoto lattice whose coupling is a tiny random neural map. Move to entrain; click to re-roll the score.

title: Latent Quicksilver
blurb: A liquid-metal isosurface of a random Fourier-feature field. Move to warp the latent; click to re-roll a new creature.

title: Diffusion Bloom
blurb: Particles reverse-diffuse from noise into form. Move to condition the score field; click to re-noise and bloom again.

title: Neural Storm
blurb: 262,144 GPU particles ride the vector field of a live neural network. Move to bend its inputs, click to mutate its weights.

title: Attention Loom
blurb: Type a sentence, hover a word, and watch toy self-attention weights stretch out as red threads.
